about.title: About me
about.subtitle: A bit about my experience and how I work
about.description: I'm a software developer experienced in designing, building and supporting enterprise systems for the public, banking and fintech sectors. I've worked with Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Angular, .NET, NestJS, PostgreSQL and Oracle.
about.bio: I build REST APIs, microservices and integrations, and work on deployments with Docker, Jenkins and Kubernetes. I enjoy solving problems, collaborating with teams and turning business needs into reliable software.
